purpose: Teach: 洗脳/疾病/空想/部族/拷問/国営/改変/公営

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんを洗脳するような医療は行いません
lines.en: Ren — we don't conduct medical care designed to manipulate patients.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady gaze. No performative gentleness, but not harsh either. The certainty of someone stating principle, not opinion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、希少な疾病の研究もされているそうですね、先生
lines.en: I've heard your hospital also conducts research on rare diseases, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful inquiry with genuine curiosity beneath. Slight lean forward. Not flattering — sincere interest in her work. Careful with the honorific.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、空想型の症状を呈する患者さんも医療チームは丁寧に診ます
lines.en: Yes — our medical team approaches patients presenting with delusional symptoms with the same care and rigor.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. A small weight on 'delusional' — not clinical coldness, but precision. Steady breathing. She's including him in her professional world.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療体制が部族別に異なる国があると、貴院、研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has researched how healthcare systems differ across cultures with different tribal or community structures, then.
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting the threads. Slightly slower pace — he's working through the implication as he speaks. Respectful but not obsequious. Genuinely impressed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、拷問被害者のトラウマケアを医療チームは行います
lines.en: Yes — our team also provides trauma care for torture survivors. It's part of our responsibility.
lines.style: Quiet conviction here. No flinch from the weight of it. Slow, deliberate. She's not softening the word 'torture' — meeting it directly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国営医療制度との比較を、貴院、論じていらっしゃいますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital addresses the comparison between public and state-run systems in that research too, I understand.
lines.style: Careful, intelligent follow-up. He's synthesizing, not just reacting. Soft, almost tentative phrasing — 'I understand' — but the question itself shows he's been listening closely.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、カルテの改変は絶対に許しません
lines.en: Correct. We absolutely will not tolerate falsification of medical records.
lines.style: Firm shift here. The lightness drops. This is non-negotiable. Clipped, clear. Not angry — glacial. The line that matters most.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 公営病院との連携、貴院は強化されているそうですね、先生
lines.en: I see — your hospital is strengthening partnerships with public institutions as well.
lines.style: Final synthesis, quiet and respectful. Closing the conversation with understanding. A small breath before speaking, like he's integrating everything he's learned. Trailing softly, almost like an acknowledgment rather than a question.
